reviewed_by: Independent static source review using saved Binary Ninja and Radare2 evidence
scope: Structural source-to-retail control-flow and call-order comparison only. No runtime or integration acceptance.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Retail Binary Ninja and Radare2 identify the same exact entry 0x00401000 and the three intraprocedural blocks.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The candidate has no explicit arguments; the retail function reads the address-backed global at 0x00536144 and passes observed scalar arguments to its callees.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The branch passes literal states 4 and 2 as shown by retail disassembly.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The candidate references the observed global 0x00536144; the object type and contents are not inferred.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Call order and conditional Flow_SetState targets match Binary Ninja disassembly and decompilation.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Control-flow exits are structurally compared here; the retail instruction writes AL only, so full EAX return semantics are unresolved and intentionally excluded.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point instructions appear in the function.

limitations: Callee implementations and their side effects are outside this function review.
The candidate reference source has no self-contained declarations for callees/global and was not independently compiled.
No paired Frida runtime capture or natural call-path observation is present.
Angr CFGFast recovered 10 instruction-split nodes; Binary Ninja and Radare2 identify 3 basic blocks with the same two branch exits.
Retail writes AL=1 after Flow_SetState; candidate int return may define upper EAX bits differently. Exact return ABI is unresolved.
